rules.text: Only fire at a robot you saw this turn, with the gun aimed at it.
rules.read_back: Whenever the robot fires a shot of any power, there must be a target that was scanned this very turn (age 0) and the gun must be pointing at it within 3.0°; if there is no such target, it does not fire.
clauses: r.fire matches Some(p) ==> ((obs.target matches Some(t) && t.age == 0) && aimed(*obs))

rules.text: Never drive toward a wall or building closer than 80 px.
rules.read_back: Whenever the robot drives forward it must leave at least 80 pixels of the free distance ahead unused (clearance ahead minus the distance driven is at least 80), and whenever it drives backward it must likewise leave at least 80 pixels of the free distance behind (clearance behind minus the distance driven backward is at least 80), with no restriction when it does not drive.
clauses: r.ahead matches Some(a) ==> (a > 0 ==> (((around.clearance_ahead as int) - (a as int)) >= 80))
r.ahead matches Some(a) ==> (a < 0 ==> (((around.clearance_behind as int) + (a as int)) >= 80))

deleted_starters.text: Never fire a shot you can't afford.

explanation.headline: Proved: both rules hold
explanation.summary: Verus proved S2 (only fire at a robot seen this turn, with the gun aimed at it) and S3 (never drive toward a wall or building closer than 80 px). Neither battle, the open arena or the city map, showed any rule violations.
